info.title: Tenrai API
info.description:
Tenrai is a free **Unofficial** public REST API for the full MyAnimeList public catalogue. Anime, manga, characters, people, producers, seasons, and more. Tenrai was built because MyAnimeList lacks a complete API of its own. Implemented endpoints follow the **Jikan v4 schema**, so an existing application can use Tenrai instead of or alongside Jikan by changing only the base URL. Please note that the API is in beta. Expect some rough edges and occasional downtime while we polish things. Thank you for being patient with us.
Patreon not yet available
--- ## Jikan v4 Notes Tenrai covers the public catalogue. Some Jikan endpoints are not available yet; we may add them in future.
AvailableAnime, manga, characters, people, producers, magazines, genres, seasons, schedules, top lists, reviews, recommendations and random
LimitedAnime /forum returns episode threads only and manga /forum chapter threads only; the filters all and other are not supported
Not available yet/users, /clubs, /watch, /random/users, and /userupdates for anime and manga
--- ## Auth & Rate Limits > Public requests work without credentials. Add `X-Server-Key` when you need higher throughput. Limits are enforced by tier. | Access | Header | RPM | RPS | RPD | |---|---|---:|---:|---:| | **Public** | *(none)* | 120 | 4 | Unlimited | | **Server Key** | `X-Server-Key` | 300 | 5 | Unlimited | Once a limit is exceeded, the API returns `429 Too Many Requests`. When you receive `429 Too Many Requests`, wait for the `Retry-After` value before retrying. Requests resume automatically after the window resets. Public limits are counted per IP address, Server Key limits per key. ### Server Key request example Pass your Server Key in the `X-Server-Key` header: ```bash curl "https://api.tenrai.org/v1/anime/38680/full" \ -H "X-Server-Key: YOUR_SERVER_KEY" ```
Keep your Server Key in server-side code and never expose it in browser or mobile client code. Server Keys are not Bearer tokens, so `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_SERVER_KEY` is not supported.
--- ## Server Keys Server Keys are private keys reserved for **[Patreon supporters](https://www.patreon.com/TenraiAPI)**. They offer higher rate limits for large-scale data work. - Despite the name, they are standard API keys that work in any project: servers, local scripts, personal databases. - Limits are enforced per key, not per IP, so a Server Key cannot raise the limits for users of a client-side or mobile app. - Server Key requests use their own cache, which keeps responses for 10 minutes, so recent data arrives sooner. - The Server Key quota stacks on top of the public quota. Requests sent without the key still count toward the public limits, so you can use both at once for more requests.
You can obtain a free temporary Server Key through our [Discord](https://discord.gg/MQ3X3sjdgK) server.
--- ## SFW Filtering SFW filtering is content-based. SFW-capable endpoints support two modes; strict mode also filters out `Ecchi`. | Mode | Parameter | Filtered Out | |---|---|---| | **Normal SFW** | `?sfw` | `R+ - Mild Nudity`, `Rx - Hentai`, `Hentai`, `Erotica` | | **Strict SFW** | `?sfw-strict` | `R+ - Mild Nudity`, `Rx - Hentai`, `Hentai`, `Erotica`, `Ecchi` | Add the name to the query string (`?sfw`) or set it to `true` to switch a mode on, and set it to `false` to switch it off. `1`/`0`, `yes`/`no` and `on`/`off` work too; any other value is refused with `400`. --- ## Caching & Data We pre-gather data algorithmically on a dynamic schedule. This difference in architecture is what allows us to offer higher rate limits, better stability and features that are unavailable in Jikan. Popular, currently airing, newly released entries etc... are updated daily and much more frequently, while older and less active titles are updated less frequently. For example: Currently airing One Piece is updated on site much more frequently than a title like Clannad that finished long ago. One Piece will therefore have a higher priority in our systems than Clannad. Scores, member statistics, rankings, metrics, things that are highly dynamic etc... are always refreshed daily regardless of entry age or status. Newly added MAL entries are made available within a few hours. Every response carries an `ETag` header. Send its value in `If-None-Match` on your next request, and you get an empty `304 Not Modified` if nothing has changed. A `304` still counts toward your rate limit. Public API responses are cached for a few hours up to a maximum of 12 hours depending on endpoint. Server Key users largely bypass this. You will notice that on some areas our data updates are much faster than Jikan, while on other areas we are slower. If you notice any issues with persistent stale data, please report it so we can refine the system. Our goal is to find the perfect balance between the amount of outbound requests and data freshness. --- ## Version 2 Version 1 (v1) is an interim version: a bridge between Tenrai and Jikan, so that an alternative to Jikan exists. It will not be perfectly polished, and we aim to move to v2 as quickly as possible. Version 2 will be the API we actually want to build, a big upgrade over anything currently available.
When v2 is available, there will be several months of notice before v1 is discontinued. For updates, join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/MQ3X3sjdgK) server.
--- ## JSON Error Response > Non-2xx error responses use a consistent JSON envelope with a machine-readable `type`, human-readable `message`, and request `path`. ```json { "status": 404, "type": "ResourceNotFoundException", "message": "Anime with ID 0 not found.", "error": "The requested resource does not exist in our database or the ID is invalid.", "path": "/v1/anime/0" } ``` | Property | Remarks | |---|---| | `status` | HTTP status code returned for the request | | `type` | Machine-readable error category | | `message` | Human-readable explanation of what happened | | `error` | Additional context or recovery guidance | | `path` | Request path that produced the error | A record that does not exist answers with the type `ResourceNotFoundException`. An address that is not part of the API answers with `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` or `NotFoundException`. --- ## User Data This API only deals with public catalogue data. It has no endpoints for user-specific data such as profiles, animelists or mangalists. If you need user data, please use the [Official MyAnimeList API](https://myanimelist.net/apiconfig/references/api/v2). --- ## Usage Policy All use cases listed below should be perfectly fine:
- Educational and university projects - Data science and research - Mobile and desktop apps - Unofficial MAL clients - Browser extensions and scripts - Bots, including Discord bots - Personal projects - Media server and metadata plugins
And much more. Please note that we don't own the data provided by the API, so we don't really have a say in what you can and can't do. --- ## Contact
DiscordThe quickest way to reach us
contact@tenrai.orgPersonal matters; a reply is not guaranteed
security@tenrai.orgSecurity issues
--- ## Disclaimer This API is provided "as is" without any warranties, express or implied. We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, or availability of the data. Use of this service is at your own risk. **By using this API, you acknowledge that you are aware of, have read, and expressly agree to be bound by our [Terms of Service](https://tenrai.org/terms).** **Tenrai and this API are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by MyAnimeList.net or its parent companies in any way.** All MyAnimeList data is property of its respective owners.

get.description:
Search and browse the full anime catalogue with advanced filters and sorting.

> SFW flags filter out non-sfw entries.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Title search query (fuzzy matched against English, Japanese, and default titles)

parameters.name: letter
parameters.description: Only anime whose title starts with this letter. One letter, in any case. Cannot be combined with `q`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Only entries with any selected type. Multiple values match any selected type.

- `tv`: TV series
- `movie`: Movie
- `ova`: OVA (original video animation)
- `special`: Special
- `ona`: ONA (original net animation, e.g. web releases)
- `music`: Music video
- `cm`: CM (commercial)
- `pv`: PV (promotional video)
- `tv_special`: TV Special

parameters.name: type_exclude
parameters.description:
Exclude entries with any selected type. Multiple values exclude any selected type.

- `tv`: TV series
- `movie`: Movie
- `ova`: OVA (original video animation)
- `special`: Special
- `ona`: ONA (original net animation, e.g. web releases)
- `music`: Music video
- `cm`: CM (commercial)
- `pv`: PV (promotional video)
- `tv_special`: TV Special

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Only entries with any selected status. Multiple values match any selected status.

- `airing`: Currently Airing
- `complete`: Finished Airing
- `upcoming`: Not yet aired

parameters.name: status_exclude
parameters.description:
Exclude entries with any selected status. Multiple values exclude any selected status.

- `airing`: Currently Airing
- `complete`: Finished Airing
- `upcoming`: Not yet aired

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description:
Only entries with any selected rating. Multiple values match any selected rating.

- `g`: G - All Ages
- `pg`: PG - Children
- `pg13`: PG-13 - Teens 13 or older
- `r17`: R - 17+ (violence & profanity)
- `r`: R+ - Mild Nudity
- `rx`: Rx - Hentai

parameters.name: rating_exclude
parameters.description:
Exclude entries with any selected rating. Multiple values exclude any selected rating. Entries without a rating are kept.

- `g`: G - All Ages
- `pg`: PG - Children
- `pg13`: PG-13 - Teens 13 or older
- `r17`: R - 17+ (violence & profanity)
- `r`: R+ - Mild Nudity
- `rx`: Rx - Hentai

parameters.name: source

- `original`: Original

parameters.name: source_exclude
parameters.description:

- `original`: Original

parameters.name: has_trailer
parameters.description: Filter by whether a main-trailer YouTube ID or URL is available. Playback availability is not checked.

parameters.name: streaming_service
parameters.description: Only anime with a streaming link from any of these providers, e.g. Crunchyroll, Netflix or HIDIVE. Names ignore capitalization, spacing and common spelling variants. Links are not checked for current availability or region.

parameters.name: has_relations
parameters.description: Filter recorded MyAnimeList relations: true includes entries with or without relations, false returns entries with no recorded relations, and only returns entries with at least one recorded relation. Includes anime and manga relations.

parameters.name: genres
parameters.description: Comma-separated IDs. Entries must have all of them.

parameters.name: genres_exclude
parameters.description: Comma-separated IDs. Entries with any of them are left out.

parameters.name: producers
parameters.description: Comma-separated IDs. Entries must have at least one of them.

parameters.name: producers_exclude
parameters.description: Exclude entries with any of these producer, studio or licensor MAL IDs. Uses the same IDs as producers.

parameters.name: staff
parameters.description: Filter by credited staff MAL person IDs. Multiple IDs match any selected person.

parameters.name: characters
parameters.description: Filter by recorded MAL character IDs. Multiple IDs match any selected character.

parameters.name: character_role
parameters.description:
Only count the characters in `characters` when MAL lists them in this role. Requires `characters`.

- `main`: Main character
- `supporting`: Supporting character

parameters.name: voice_actors
parameters.description: Filter by recorded voice-actor MAL person IDs. Multiple IDs match any selected person. With `characters`, a selected person must voice a selected character in that anime, in the `character_role` and the `voice_language` when they are given too.

parameters.name: voice_language
parameters.description:
Only anime with a voice cast credited in any of these languages, e.g. an English dub. When used with `voice_actors`, a selected voice actor must be credited in that language. A credited dub doesn't mean it can be streamed.

- `english`: English
- `french`: French
- `german`: German
- `hebrew`: Hebrew
- `hungarian`: Hungarian
- `italian`: Italian
- `japanese`: Japanese
- `korean`: Korean
- `mandarin`: Mandarin
- `portuguese_br`: Portuguese (BR)
- `spanish`: Spanish

parameters.name: min_id
parameters.description: Minimum MAL ID, inclusive.

parameters.name: max_id
parameters.description: Maximum MAL ID, inclusive.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Only search within the entries whose MAL IDs you choose, such as the ones on a user's list. All other filters and sorting still apply. Comma-separated. These answers are never cached.

parameters.name: exclude_ids
parameters.description: Exclude the entries whose MAL IDs you choose, such as the ones already on a user's list. Comma-separated. These answers are never cached.

parameters.name: score
parameters.description: Only entries with exactly this score, e.g. `8.2` for 8.20. Cannot be combined with `min_score` or `max_score`; use those for a range.

parameters.name: min_score
parameters.description: Only entries with this score or higher.

parameters.name: max_score
parameters.description: Only entries with this score or lower.

parameters.name: min_scored_by
parameters.description: Minimum number of scoring users, inclusive.

parameters.name: max_scored_by
parameters.description: Maximum number of scoring users, inclusive.

parameters.name: min_reviews
parameters.description: Minimum number of available reviews, inclusive, including spoiler and preliminary reviews. This is not a complete MyAnimeList-wide total. 0 applies no limit.

parameters.name: max_reviews
parameters.description: Maximum number of available reviews, inclusive, including spoiler and preliminary reviews. This is not a complete MyAnimeList-wide total. 0 returns entries with no stored reviews.

parameters.name: min_members
parameters.description: Minimum member count, inclusive.

parameters.name: max_members
parameters.description: Maximum member count, inclusive.

parameters.name: min_favorites
parameters.description: Minimum favorites count, inclusive.

parameters.name: max_favorites
parameters.description: Maximum favorites count, inclusive.

parameters.name: min_episodes
parameters.description: Minimum known positive episode count, inclusive.

parameters.name: max_episodes
parameters.description: Maximum known positive episode count, inclusive.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Calendar year of the aired or published start date. Cannot be combined with min_year or max_year. For anime, this can differ from MAL's season year. Multiple years match any selected year.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Filter by MAL's debut-season classification. Multiple seasons match any selected season.

parameters.name: season_year
parameters.description: Filter by MAL's debut-season year. This can differ from the calendar start year. Multiple years match any selected year; with `season`, any selected season of any selected year matches.

parameters.name: broadcast_day
parameters.description: Filter by the day of the week the anime airs in Japan (JST). Multiple days match any selected day. `other` matches anime that MAL lists without a regular day. Anime without a recorded broadcast day never match. `today` and `tomorrow` follow the date in Japan, so they move on at midnight Japan time (15:00 UTC).

parameters.name: min_year
parameters.description: Minimum calendar year of the aired or published start date, inclusive. For anime, this can differ from MAL's season year.

parameters.name: max_year
parameters.description: Maximum calendar year of the aired or published start date, inclusive. For anime, this can differ from MAL's season year.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Only anime that started airing on or after this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. A year (2020) or a year and month (2020-05) is also accepted.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Only anime that finished airing on or before this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. A year (2020) or a year and month (2020-05) is also accepted and covers up to its last day. Anime with no end date, such as films shown on a single day, are left out, as on Jikan.

parameters.name: added_after
parameters.description: Only anime that MAL added on or after this date (UTC). Format: YYYY-MM-DD. A year (2026) or a year and month (2026-10) is also accepted and means its first day. Only works with approved anime: unapproved anime are never matched, even with `unapproved`.

parameters.name: added_before
parameters.description: Only anime that MAL added on or before this UTC date. Use YYYY-MM-DD for a day, YYYY-MM for the whole month, or YYYY for the whole year. Only works with approved anime: unapproved anime are never matched, even with `unapproved`.

parameters.name: sfw
parameters.description: Filter adult content.

parameters.name: sfw-strict
parameters.description: Apply strict SFW filtering for adult content and Ecchi.

parameters.name: unapproved
parameters.description: When true, also includes unapproved entries.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description:
Field to sort the results by.

- `mal_id`: MAL ID
- `title`: Title
- `title_english`: English title
- `title_japanese`: Japanese title
- `start_date`: Start date
- `end_date`: End date
- `episodes`: Number of episodes
- `score`: Score
- `scored_by`: Number of users who scored it
- `rank`: Rank
- `popularity`: Popularity rank
- `members`: Members
- `favorites`: Favorites
- `added`: Date MAL added it, newest first with `sort=desc`; approved anime only, even with `unapproved`
- `score_change_30d`: Change in MAL score over 30 days
- `score_spread`: Standard deviation of user scores; higher means more disagreement
- `members_gained_7d`: Net change in members over 7 days

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort direction: `asc` for ascending, `desc` for descending. Only applies together with `order_by`.

parameters.name: nulls
parameters.description: Applies to the field you sort by with `order_by`. `first` puts entries without a value first, `last` puts them last, and `exclude` leaves them out of results and totals. Example: `order_by=end_date&nulls=exclude` leaves out entries without an end date. Requires `order_by`. When omitted, entries without a value come first with sort=asc and last with sort=desc. With `order_by=rank` or `order_by=popularity`, they come last either way, and a rank or popularity of 0 counts as no value.

parameters.description: Page number

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page

data.title: Cowboy Bebop
data.synopsis:
Crime is timeless. By the year 2071, humanity has expanded across the galaxy, filling the surface of other planets with settlements like those on Earth. These new societies are plagued by murder, drug use, and theft, and intergalactic outlaws are hunted by a growing number of tough bounty hunters.

Spike Spiegel and Jet Black pursue criminals throughout space to make a humble living. Beneath his goofy and aloof demeanor, Spike is haunted by the weight of his violent past. Meanwhile, Jet manages his own troubled memories while taking care of Spike and the Bebop, their ship. The duo is joined by the beautiful con artist Faye Valentine, odd child Edward Wong Hau Pepelu Tivrusky IV, and Ein, a bioengineered Welsh corgi.

While developing bonds and working to catch a colorful cast of criminals, the Bebop crew's lives are disrupted by a menace from Spike's past. As a rival's maniacal plot continues to unravel, Spike must choose between life with his newfound family or revenge for his old wounds.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
data.background:
When Cowboy Bebop first aired in spring of 1998 on TV Tokyo, only episodes 2-3, 7-15, and 18 were broadcast, it was concluded with a recap special known as Yose Atsume Blues. This was due to anime censorship having increased following the big controversies over Evangelion, as a result most of the series was pulled from the air due to violent content. Satellite channel WOWOW picked up the series in the fall of that year and aired it in its entirety uncensored. Cowboy Bebop was not a ratings hit in Japan, but sold over 19,000 DVD units in the initial release run, and 81,000 overall. Protagonist Spike Spiegel won Best Male Character, and Megumi Hayashibara won Best Voice Actor for her role as Faye Valentine in the 1999 and 2000 Anime Grand Prix, respectively.



Cowboy Bebop's biggest influence has been in the United States, where it premiered on Adult Swim in 2001 with many reruns since. The show's heavy Western influence struck a chord with American viewers, where it became a "gateway drug" to anime aimed at adult audiences.

304.description: Not Modified - the response has not changed since the ETag sent in If-None-Match

ETag.description: Identifies this version of the response. Send it in If-None-Match to check whether it has changed.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid parameters or request body

value.error: Check the request parameters against the documentation and try again.
The request is malformed or not shaped like a supported Tenrai API request.

401.description: Unauthorized - the supplied X-Server-Key is invalid; restricted endpoints also require a Server Key

data.title: Cowboy Bebop
data.synopsis:
Crime is timeless. By the year 2071, humanity has expanded across the galaxy, filling the surface of other planets with settlements like those on Earth. These new societies are plagued by murder, drug use, and theft, and intergalactic outlaws are hunted by a growing number of tough bounty hunters.

Spike Spiegel and Jet Black pursue criminals throughout space to make a humble living. Beneath his goofy and aloof demeanor, Spike is haunted by the weight of his violent past. Meanwhile, Jet manages his own troubled memories while taking care of Spike and the Bebop, their ship. The duo is joined by the beautiful con artist Faye Valentine, odd child Edward Wong Hau Pepelu Tivrusky IV, and Ein, a bioengineered Welsh corgi.

While developing bonds and working to catch a colorful cast of criminals, the Bebop crew's lives are disrupted by a menace from Spike's past. As a rival's maniacal plot continues to unravel, Spike must choose between life with his newfound family or revenge for his old wounds.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
data.background:
When Cowboy Bebop first aired in spring of 1998 on TV Tokyo, only episodes 2-3, 7-15, and 18 were broadcast, it was concluded with a recap special known as Yose Atsume Blues. This was due to anime censorship having increased following the big controversies over Evangelion, as a result most of the series was pulled from the air due to violent content. Satellite channel WOWOW picked up the series in the fall of that year and aired it in its entirety uncensored. Cowboy Bebop was not a ratings hit in Japan, but sold over 19,000 DVD units in the initial release run, and 81,000 overall. Protagonist Spike Spiegel won Best Male Character, and Megumi Hayashibara won Best Voice Actor for her role as Faye Valentine in the 1999 and 2000 Anime Grand Prix, respectively.



Cowboy Bebop's biggest influence has been in the United States, where it premiered on Adult Swim in 2001 with many reruns since. The show's heavy Western influence struck a chord with American viewers, where it became a "gateway drug" to anime aimed at adult audiences.

included.title: Naruto
included.synopsis:
Twelve years ago, a colossal demon fox terrorized the world. During the monster's attack on the Hidden Leaf Village, the Hokage—the village's leader and most powerful ninja—sacrifices himself to seal the beast inside a newborn, relieving civilization from destruction while dooming the baby to a lonely life.

Now, after years of being shunned and bullied, Naruto Uzumaki pesters the village with elaborate pranks and vandalism. Despite these antics, he works hard to achieve his dream: to become the Hokage and earn the acknowledgement of those who have mistreated him for his entire life. Naruto joins Team 7, a ninja squad made up of two of his peers—prodigy Sasuke Uchiha and clever Sakura Haruno.

Under the aloof Kakashi Hatake's leadership, Team 7 takes on a series of difficult missions, forcing its members to grow in strength and comradery despite their many differences. Naruto strives to stand out in his rivalry with Sasuke and earn the romantic affection of Sakura. But as the trio brush against danger and death, their tragic pasts threaten to tear them apart.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
included.background:
Naruto received numerous awards during its airing, including the Best Full-Length Animation Program Award in the third UStv Awards and the 38th Best Animated Show in IGN's Top 100 Animated Series.



The anime was released on DVD in 16 volumes by VIZ Media from July 4, 2006, to September 22, 2009. The company rereleased it in eight volumes from October 6, 2009, to December 14, 2010. VIZ Media also made available a Blu-ray version in eight volumes from November 3, 2020, to October 18, 2022.



The series adapts the first 27 volumes of the original manga.

included.title: Death Note
included.synopsis:
Brutal murders, petty thefts, and senseless violence pollute the human world. In contrast, the realm of death gods is a humdrum, unchanging gambling den. The ingenious 17-year-old Japanese student Light Yagami and sadistic god of death Ryuk share one belief: their worlds are rotten.

For his own amusement, Ryuk drops his Death Note into the human world. Light stumbles upon it, deeming the first of its rules ridiculous: the human whose name is written in this note shall die. However, the temptation is too great, and Light experiments by writing a felon's name, which disturbingly enacts his first murder.

Aware of the terrifying godlike power that has fallen into his hands, Light—under the alias Kira—follows his wicked sense of justice with the ultimate goal of cleansing the world of all evil-doers. The meticulous mastermind detective L is already on his trail, but as Light's brilliance rivals L's, the grand chase for Kira turns into an intense battle of wits that can only end when one of them is dead.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

data.title: Cowboy Bebop
data.synopsis:
Crime is timeless. By the year 2071, humanity has expanded across the galaxy, filling the surface of other planets with settlements like those on Earth. These new societies are plagued by murder, drug use, and theft, and intergalactic outlaws are hunted by a growing number of tough bounty hunters.

Spike Spiegel and Jet Black pursue criminals throughout space to make a humble living. Beneath his goofy and aloof demeanor, Spike is haunted by the weight of his violent past. Meanwhile, Jet manages his own troubled memories while taking care of Spike and the Bebop, their ship. The duo is joined by the beautiful con artist Faye Valentine, odd child Edward Wong Hau Pepelu Tivrusky IV, and Ein, a bioengineered Welsh corgi.

While developing bonds and working to catch a colorful cast of criminals, the Bebop crew's lives are disrupted by a menace from Spike's past. As a rival's maniacal plot continues to unravel, Spike must choose between life with his newfound family or revenge for his old wounds.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
data.background:
When Cowboy Bebop first aired in spring of 1998 on TV Tokyo, only episodes 2-3, 7-15, and 18 were broadcast, it was concluded with a recap special known as Yose Atsume Blues. This was due to anime censorship having increased following the big controversies over Evangelion, as a result most of the series was pulled from the air due to violent content. Satellite channel WOWOW picked up the series in the fall of that year and aired it in its entirety uncensored. Cowboy Bebop was not a ratings hit in Japan, but sold over 19,000 DVD units in the initial release run, and 81,000 overall. Protagonist Spike Spiegel won Best Male Character, and Megumi Hayashibara won Best Voice Actor for her role as Faye Valentine in the 1999 and 2000 Anime Grand Prix, respectively.



Cowboy Bebop's biggest influence has been in the United States, where it premiered on Adult Swim in 2001 with many reruns since. The show's heavy Western influence struck a chord with American viewers, where it became a "gateway drug" to anime aimed at adult audiences.

data.title: Asteroid Blues
data.title_japanese: アステロイド・ブルース
data.synopsis:
In a flashback, Spike Spiegel is shown waiting near a church holding a bouquet of flowers, before leaving as the church bell rings. As he walks away, images of a gunfight he participated in are shown. In the present, Spike, currently a bounty hunter, and his partner Jet Black head to the Tijuana asteroid colony on their ship, the Bebop, to track down a bounty-head named Asimov Solensan. Asimov is wanted for killing members of his own crime syndicate and for stealing a cache of a dangerous combat drug known as Bloody-Eye. On the colony, Asimov and his girlfriend, Katerina, are ambushed at a bar by his former syndicate while attempting to sell a vial of Bloody-Eye, but Asimov manages to fight his way out by using the drug himself. Spike later encounters Katerina and reveals to her that he is a bounty hunter searching for Asimov; Spike is promptly assaulted by Asimov and is nearly killed before Katerina intervenes. In the confusion, Spike is able to steal Asimov's Bloody-Eye vial before the two leave. Spike later confronts Asimov at a staged drug deal with the stolen vial, but Asimov escapes with Katerina in a ship when the two are interrupted by an attack from Asimov's former syndicate. With Spike giving chase in his own ship, Asimov attempts to take another dose of Bloody-Eye, but a horrified Katerina shoots him before he can. As Spike approaches Asimov's ship, it is destroyed by attacking police cruisers, forcing Spike to pull away. The episode ends with Spike and Jet once again traveling through space on the Bebop.

(Source: Wikipedia)

data.title: Asteroid Blues
data.title_japanese: アステロイド・ブルース
data.synopsis:
In a flashback, Spike Spiegel is shown waiting near a church holding a bouquet of flowers, before leaving as the church bell rings. As he walks away, images of a gunfight he participated in are shown. In the present, Spike, currently a bounty hunter, and his partner Jet Black head to the Tijuana asteroid colony on their ship, the Bebop, to track down a bounty-head named Asimov Solensan. Asimov is wanted for killing members of his own crime syndicate and for stealing a cache of a dangerous combat drug known as Bloody-Eye. On the colony, Asimov and his girlfriend, Katerina, are ambushed at a bar by his former syndicate while attempting to sell a vial of Bloody-Eye, but Asimov manages to fight his way out by using the drug himself. Spike later encounters Katerina and reveals to her that he is a bounty hunter searching for Asimov; Spike is promptly assaulted by Asimov and is nearly killed before Katerina intervenes. In the confusion, Spike is able to steal Asimov's Bloody-Eye vial before the two leave. Spike later confronts Asimov at a staged drug deal with the stolen vial, but Asimov escapes with Katerina in a ship when the two are interrupted by an attack from Asimov's former syndicate. With Spike giving chase in his own ship, Asimov attempts to take another dose of Bloody-Eye, but a horrified Katerina shoots him before he can. As Spike approaches Asimov's ship, it is destroyed by attacking police cruisers, forcing Spike to pull away. The episode ends with Spike and Jet once again traveling through space on the Bebop.

(Source: Wikipedia)

get.description:
Get user reviews of an anime.

Spoiler and preliminary reviews are hidden unless you ask for them.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The MAL Anime ID

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Only content written by this MyAnimeList user. Matches the full username.

parameters.name: sentiment
parameters.description: Only reviews with any selected sentiment. Separate multiple values with commas.

parameters.name: reaction
parameters.description: Only reviews with at least one reaction of each selected kind. Separate multiple values with commas. Use min_reaction_count to set a higher threshold.

parameters.name: min_reaction_count
parameters.description: Minimum reactions of each selected kind, inclusive. Requires reaction.

parameters.name: min_reactions
parameters.description: Minimum total reactions on the review, inclusive. Uses reactions.overall.

parameters.name: max_reactions
parameters.description: Maximum total reactions on the review, inclusive. Uses reactions.overall.

parameters.name: preliminary
parameters.description:
Filter preliminary reviews (true = include, false = exclude, only = exclusive).  
Preliminary reviews are left out unless this is set.

parameters.name: spoilers
parameters.description:
Filter spoiler reviews (true = include, false = exclude, only = exclusive).  
Spoiler reviews are left out unless this is set.

parameters.name: score
parameters.description: Only reviews whose writer gave this exact score, from 1 to 10.

parameters.name: min_score
parameters.description: Minimum score given by the reviewer, inclusive.

parameters.name: max_score
parameters.description: Maximum score given by the reviewer, inclusive.

parameters.name: published_after
parameters.description:
Only reviews posted on or after this date or timestamp.

Use a date (`2026-11-04`) or a timestamp with seconds and a time zone (`2026-11-04T18:30:00Z` or `2026-11-04T20:30:00+02:00`). A date covers the whole UTC day.

parameters.name: published_before
parameters.description:
Only reviews posted on or before this date or timestamp.

Use a date (`2026-11-04`) or a timestamp with seconds and a time zone (`2026-11-04T18:30:00Z` or `2026-11-04T20:30:00+02:00`). A date covers the whole UTC day.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Use score to show the highest reviewer scores first, or a reaction kind such as funny to show the reviews with the most reactions of that kind first. The selected sort breaks ties.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order of the reviews: newest first, oldest first or most helpful first.

parameters.name: nulls
parameters.description: Place reviews missing the active sorting value first or last, or exclude them from results and pagination. When omitted, missing dates come first with newest and last with oldest. Missing helpfulness and reviewer scores come last. A score of zero means the reviewer did not rate the entry.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number

schema.description: Successful response returning anime reviews

data.review:
People who know me know that I'm not a fan of episodic anime series unless they're either one season (12-14 episodes) long or a slice of life series. Why? They have a tendency to get boring, or repetitive. But all rules and preferences have exceptions. You know what? Cowboy Bebop is that exception.

The story is set in a space western setting - a genre and setting I'm loving more and more for each show I watch that falls under the genre. We follow two bounty hunters, Spike and Jet, who own a ship called the Bebop. They travel the Solar system, chasing wanted criminals to earn money. Along the way, they also pick up two women; the debt-laden Faye Valentine and the playful kid and computer genius Edward (yes, Ed’s a girl). 

Each episode brings about a new bounty which they chase after, and while that doesn't sound too exciting to watch 26 episodes in a row, you'll end up loving the show. All the different events makes for a certain degree of unpredictability, and you'll sometimes wonder how things will end. However, that alone is not enough to give the story the rating I've given it. So why have I given that rating? Let's continue...

One of the things that elevate the show a bit above the rest is the manner in which the main cast's pasts are explored. It's not like one flashback episode and you understand everything about how they are today. In one episode you might get one piece, and then the next one in another episode, and it's not until the final three episodes of the show that everything falls in place. This way of executing it makes you want to watch another episode, so that you can find out more about the characters (some may say that this falls in under "Character", but the manner in which the pasts are explored are more "Story" than "Character", IMO). Now, that's so far a 9 for the story. Why did it deserve a 10?

The answer is easy: the way they executed many scenes in the show. The contrasts which you get to see between, music, the setting of scenes and what's really happening just gives the story that extra edge deserving of a perfect score.

The characters are all really good and interesting fellows. Though they every now and then reminded me of characters from other shows, they preserved that originality which gave a feel that they were, if not completely, then at least a little bit more real than most characters out there. The way their pasts intertwine with the future and how everything ends with them confronting and settling open ends from their pasts is also something that's impressive to watch. I don't really have anything more to say than "perfect".

The animation is, for a 90s anime, stunningly good. The detail put into backgrounds and surroundings is really good, and I also love how good lighting effects and shading are at times. All of Ed’s strange movements are animated really nicely too. If there's something negative, it's the somewhat dull coloring (compared to today's standards), as well as poor effects when traveling in hyperspace.

The soundtrack is also astounding! The music used for the show is so incredibly varied, and while keeping mostly to the more jazzy tunes, the soundtrack visits so many genres that it's hard to not like at least a few pieces. What I also loved is the way the music was used not only as a medium to go with and amplify the mood, but also as a contrast to what's happening in several scenes. All in all, it's really amazing. Don't have anything to say against voice acting and other sound effects either.

All in all Cowboy Bebop is an anime that’s in the top tier on the greatness scale, and a show I believe every anime fan should give a try.

To 'Not Helpful' voters (and you 'Helpful' voters too): Feedback greatly appreciated =)

Search and browse the full manga catalogue with advanced filters and sorting.

> SFW flags filter out non-sfw entries.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Title search query

parameters.name: letter
parameters.description: Only manga whose title starts with this letter. One letter, in any case. Cannot be combined with `q`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
Only entries with any selected type. Multiple values match any selected type.

- `manga`: Manga
- `novel`: Novel
- `lightnovel`: Light Novel
- `oneshot`: One-shot
- `doujin`: Doujinshi (self-published)
- `manhwa`: Manhwa (Korean comics)
- `manhua`: Manhua (Chinese comics)

parameters.name: type_exclude
parameters.description:
Exclude entries with any selected type. Multiple values exclude any selected type.

- `manga`: Manga
- `novel`: Novel
- `lightnovel`: Light Novel
- `oneshot`: One-shot
- `doujin`: Doujinshi (self-published)
- `manhwa`: Manhwa (Korean comics)
- `manhua`: Manhua (Chinese comics)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
Only entries with any selected status. Multiple values match any selected status.

- `publishing`: Publishing
- `complete`: Finished
- `upcoming`: Not yet published
- `discontinued`: Discontinued
- `hiatus`: On Hiatus

parameters.name: status_exclude
parameters.description:
Exclude entries with any selected status. Multiple values exclude any selected status.

- `publishing`: Publishing
- `complete`: Finished
- `upcoming`: Not yet published
- `discontinued`: Discontinued
- `hiatus`: On Hiatus

parameters.name: has_relations
parameters.description: Filter recorded MyAnimeList relations: true includes entries with or without relations, false returns entries with no recorded relations, and only returns entries with at least one recorded relation. Includes anime and manga relations.

parameters.name: genres
parameters.description: Comma-separated IDs. Entries must have all of them.

parameters.name: genres_exclude
parameters.description: Comma-separated IDs. Entries with any of them are left out.

parameters.name: magazines
parameters.description: Comma-separated IDs. Entries must have at least one of them.

parameters.name: magazines_exclude
parameters.description: Exclude entries recorded under any selected magazine or serialization-platform MAL ID.

parameters.name: authors
parameters.description: Filter by credited author or artist MAL person IDs. Multiple IDs match any selected author.

parameters.name: author_role
parameters.description: Only count the authors in `authors` when MAL credits them with this role: `story` for the writing, `art` for the drawing. An author credited with Story & Art matches both. Requires `authors`.

parameters.name: solo_author
parameters.description: Filter by who made the manga: `true` for manga written and drawn by one person, `false` for manga whose writing and art are credited to two or more people. Manga that MAL lists without both a writer and an artist match neither.

parameters.name: authors_exclude
parameters.description: Exclude manga by any of these author MAL person IDs, in any role. Uses the same IDs as authors.

parameters.name: characters
parameters.description: Filter by recorded MAL character IDs. Multiple IDs match any selected character.

parameters.name: character_role
parameters.description:
Only count the characters in `characters` when MAL lists them in this role. Requires `characters`.

- `main`: Main character
- `supporting`: Supporting character

parameters.name: min_id
parameters.description: Minimum MAL ID, inclusive.

parameters.name: max_id
parameters.description: Maximum MAL ID, inclusive.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Only search within the entries whose MAL IDs you choose, such as the ones on a user's list. All other filters and sorting still apply. Comma-separated. These answers are never cached.

parameters.name: exclude_ids
parameters.description: Exclude the entries whose MAL IDs you choose, such as the ones already on a user's list. Comma-separated. These answers are never cached.

parameters.name: score
parameters.description: Only entries with exactly this score, e.g. `8.2` for 8.20. Cannot be combined with `min_score` or `max_score`; use those for a range.

parameters.name: min_score
parameters.description: Only entries with this score or higher.

parameters.name: max_score
parameters.description: Only entries with this score or lower.

parameters.name: min_scored_by
parameters.description: Minimum number of scoring users, inclusive.

parameters.name: max_scored_by
parameters.description: Maximum number of scoring users, inclusive.

parameters.name: min_reviews
parameters.description: Minimum number of available reviews, inclusive, including spoiler and preliminary reviews. This is not a complete MyAnimeList-wide total. 0 applies no limit.

parameters.name: max_reviews
parameters.description: Maximum number of available reviews, inclusive, including spoiler and preliminary reviews. This is not a complete MyAnimeList-wide total. 0 returns entries with no stored reviews.

parameters.description: Minimum member count, inclusive.

parameters.name: max_members
parameters.description: Maximum member count, inclusive.

parameters.name: min_favorites
parameters.description: Minimum favorites count, inclusive.

parameters.name: max_favorites
parameters.description: Maximum favorites count, inclusive.

parameters.name: min_chapters
parameters.description: Minimum known positive chapter count, inclusive.

parameters.name: max_chapters
parameters.description: Maximum known positive chapter count, inclusive.

parameters.name: min_volumes
parameters.description: Minimum known positive volume count, inclusive.

parameters.name: max_volumes
parameters.description: Maximum known positive volume count, inclusive.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Calendar year of the aired or published start date. Cannot be combined with min_year or max_year. For anime, this can differ from MAL's season year. Multiple years match any selected year.

parameters.name: min_year
parameters.description: Minimum calendar year of the aired or published start date, inclusive. For anime, this can differ from MAL's season year.

parameters.name: max_year
parameters.description: Maximum calendar year of the aired or published start date, inclusive. For anime, this can differ from MAL's season year.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Only manga that started publishing on or after this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. A year (2020) or a year and month (2020-05) is also accepted.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Only manga that finished publishing on or before this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. A year (2020) or a year and month (2020-05) is also accepted and covers up to its last day. Manga with no end date, such as one-shots published on a single day, are left out, as on Jikan.

parameters.name: sfw
parameters.description: Filter adult content.

parameters.name: sfw-strict
parameters.description: Apply strict SFW filtering for adult content and Ecchi.

parameters.name: unapproved
parameters.description: When true, also includes unapproved entries.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description:
Field to sort the results by.

- `mal_id`: MAL ID
- `title`: Title
- `title_english`: English title
- `title_japanese`: Japanese title
- `start_date`: Start date
- `end_date`: End date
- `chapters`: Number of chapters
- `volumes`: Number of volumes
- `score`: Score
- `scored_by`: Number of users who scored it
- `rank`: Rank
- `popularity`: Popularity rank
- `members`: Members
- `favorites`: Favorites
- `score_change_30d`: Change in MAL score over 30 days
- `score_spread`: Standard deviation of user scores; higher means more disagreement
- `members_gained_7d`: Net change in members over 7 days

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort direction: `asc` for ascending, `desc` for descending. Only applies together with `order_by`.

parameters.name: nulls
parameters.description: Applies to the field you sort by with `order_by`. `first` puts entries without a value first, `last` puts them last, and `exclude` leaves them out of results and totals. Example: `order_by=end_date&nulls=exclude` leaves out entries without an end date. Requires `order_by`. When omitted, entries without a value come first with sort=asc and last with sort=desc. With `order_by=rank` or `order_by=popularity`, they come last either way, and a rank or popularity of 0 counts as no value.

data.title: Monster
data.synopsis:
Kenzou Tenma, a renowned Japanese neurosurgeon working in post-war Germany, faces a difficult choice: to operate on Johan Liebert, an orphan boy on the verge of death, or on the mayor of Düsseldorf. In the end, Tenma decides to gamble his reputation by saving Johan, effectively leaving the mayor for dead.

As a consequence of his actions, hospital director Heinemann strips Tenma of his position, and Heinemann's daughter Eva breaks off their engagement. Disgraced and shunned by his colleagues, Tenma loses all hope of a successful career—that is, until the mysterious killing of Heinemann gives him another chance.

Nine years later, Tenma is the head of the surgical department and close to becoming the director himself. Although all seems well for him at first, he soon becomes entangled in a chain of gruesome murders that have taken place throughout Germany. The culprit is a monster—the same one that Tenma saved on that fateful day nine years ago.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
data.background: Monster won the Grand Prize at the third Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in 1999, as well as the 46th Shogakukan Manga Award in the General category in 2000. The series was published in English by VIZ Media under its VIZ Signature imprint from February 21, 2006, to December 16, 2008, and again in 2-in-1 omnibuses under the subtitle The Perfect Edition. The manga was also published in Brazilian Portuguese by Panini Comics from June 2012 to April 2015; in Polish by Hanami from March 28, 2014, to February 1, 2017; in Spain by Planeta Cómic from June 16, 2009, to September 21, 2010; in Argentina by Editorial Ivrea and LARP Editores; and in Turkey by Marmara Çizgi.

data.title: Monster
data.synopsis:
Kenzou Tenma, a renowned Japanese neurosurgeon working in post-war Germany, faces a difficult choice: to operate on Johan Liebert, an orphan boy on the verge of death, or on the mayor of Düsseldorf. In the end, Tenma decides to gamble his reputation by saving Johan, effectively leaving the mayor for dead.

As a consequence of his actions, hospital director Heinemann strips Tenma of his position, and Heinemann's daughter Eva breaks off their engagement. Disgraced and shunned by his colleagues, Tenma loses all hope of a successful career—that is, until the mysterious killing of Heinemann gives him another chance.

Nine years later, Tenma is the head of the surgical department and close to becoming the director himself. Although all seems well for him at first, he soon becomes entangled in a chain of gruesome murders that have taken place throughout Germany. The culprit is a monster—the same one that Tenma saved on that fateful day nine years ago.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
data.background: Monster won the Grand Prize at the third Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in 1999, as well as the 46th Shogakukan Manga Award in the General category in 2000. The series was published in English by VIZ Media under its VIZ Signature imprint from February 21, 2006, to December 16, 2008, and again in 2-in-1 omnibuses under the subtitle The Perfect Edition. The manga was also published in Brazilian Portuguese by Panini Comics from June 2012 to April 2015; in Polish by Hanami from March 28, 2014, to February 1, 2017; in Spain by Planeta Cómic from June 16, 2009, to September 21, 2010; in Argentina by Editorial Ivrea and LARP Editores; and in Turkey by Marmara Çizgi.

included.title: Berserk
included.synopsis:
Guts, a former mercenary now known as the Black Swordsman, is out for revenge. After a tumultuous childhood, he finally finds someone he respects and believes he can trust, only to have everything fall apart when this person takes away everything important to Guts for the purpose of fulfilling his own desires. Now marked for death, Guts becomes condemned to a fate in which he is relentlessly pursued by demonic beings.

Setting out on a dreadful quest riddled with misfortune, Guts, armed with a massive sword and monstrous strength, will let nothing stop him, not even death itself, until he is finally able to take the head of the one who stripped him—and his loved one—of their humanity.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

Included one-shot:
Volume 14: Berserk: The Prototype
included.background: Berserk won the Excellence Award at the sixth Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in 2002. As of August 2025, over 70 million copies of the manga are in circulation. The series has been published in English by Dark Horse Comics since November 4, 2003. It has also been released in Argentina, Brazil, Czech Republic, France, Germany, Greece, Hong Kong, Italy, México, Poland, South Korea, Spain, Taiwan, Thailand, and Turkey. In May 2021, the author Kentaro Miura suddenly died at the age of 54. Chapter 364 of Berserk was published posthumously on September 10, 2021. Miura would often share details about the series' story with his childhood friend and fellow mangaka Kouji Mori. The series resumed on June 24, 2022, with Studio Gaga handling the art and Kouji Mori's supervision.

entry.name: Berserk: Ougon Jidai-hen I - Haou no Tamago

included.moreinfo:
Berserk: The Prototype (1988)

Before Berserk became what it is now, Miura Kentaro created a prototype chapter for the manga. The year was 1988 and he was still a student at that time. This is the prototype manga on which the Berserk manga is based.



Chapter count includes 380 chapters as of volume 41.

included.title: 20th Century Boys
included.synopsis:
As the 20th century approaches its end, people all over the world are anxious that the world is changing. And probably not for the better.

Kenji Endou is a normal convenience store manager who is just trying to get by. But when he learns that one of his old friends going by the name "Donkey" has suddenly committed suicide and that a new cult led by a figure known as "Friend" is becoming more notorious, Kenji starts to feel that something is not right. With a few key clues left behind by his deceased friend, Kenji realizes that this cult is much more than he ever thought it would be—not only is this mysterious organization directly targeting him and his childhood friends, but the whole world also faces a grave danger that only the friends have the key to stop.

Kenji's simple life of barely making ends meet is flipped upside down when he reunites with his childhood friends, and together they must figure out the truth of how their past is connected to the cult, as the turn of the century could mean the possible end of the world.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
included.background: 20th Century Boys won the Kodansha Manga Award in the general category in 2001, an Excellence Prize at the Japan Media Arts Festival in 2002, and the Shogakukan Manga Award in the general category in 2003. The series' combined storyline won the Grand Prize at the 37th Japan Cartoonist Awards on May 9, 2008. VIZ Media published the series in English under the VIZ Signature imprint from February 17, 2009, to September 18, 2012. VIZ Media licensed the series in 2005; however, at Urasawa's request, it was rescheduled for release after Monster finished its English publication due to a change in art style over time. It was also published as 2-in-1 omnibus volumes from September 18, 2018, to March 16, 2021. The series has also been published in Brazilian Portuguese by Panini Comics/Planet Manga since September 2012. The series was adapted into a trilogy of live-action films which released in Japan between August 30, 2008, and August 29, 2009.

data.review:
I rarely give tens to mangas. But this one just deserves it! Why? I'm going to tell you:

Monster isn't a tradional manga. It isn't about fighting. I even dare to say it is a 'Love it or hate it'-manga. If you are the type of Naruto and Bleach and looking for that kind of manga, this isn't the manga for you. If you are looking for an intense, well-written manga, I would recommend this certainly for you.

The story is complex and long. Altough it's long, there isn't one single filler. It is all part of the same story. The story is about several characters, whom all have their own background and story. All the characters, you could just find them in real-life. And that is awesome. It all feels real and the flow of the story is... perfect.

The art was fine, although it isn't traditional drawn. Sometimes I thought the art was too unrealistic for the story. Some of the guys had way too big noses and stuff, but it wasn't really bothering though. 

I think it is hard to explain what is so perfect about this manga. The story is excellent, I think that is the main thing why I just like it so much. It is complex and intense, just like I said before. You will like the characters and follow their lives troughout the story. Tenma, the main character, goes from place to place and you get a peek into lives of other people. That is done so fantastic and real that you'll just start loving all those good people. 

The story is so complex, it left me with quite some questions. It is a manga in which not everything will be explained. You will have to live with that and make conclusion for your own. I didn't like that first, but now I realise it perhaps is just fine. The actions of humans aren't always explained in real-life either....

My conclusion: This manga is perfect for everyone who loves thrillers and tension! The 10 it has gotten from me, well, it just deserves it!

data.title: Crepuscule (Yamachi)
data.synopsis:
Crepuscule is a Korean Webtoon from Naver. It is written by Mirchi and the art is done by Yamchi.
Lark is different from the rest of the kids. He has red eyes and he is bullied by the other kids for that. One day he meets Setz, a genuine vampire of a noble clan, who is the only one who doesn't call him a monster. Eventually, they become friends, but when an incident happens, Setz doesn't want to lose a friend, so he invites Lark to his home... The world of Vampires....

There are two Webtoons released. The first one was discontinued and the artist restarted the story with a new author, with a few changes in the storyline.
(http://crepuscule.wikia.com/wiki/Crepuscule_Wiki)

parameters.description:
Exclude entries with any selected type. Multiple values exclude any selected type.

- `manga`: Manga

- `manhua`: Manhua (Chinese comics)

- `publishing`: Publishing
- `complete`: Finished
- `upcoming`: Not yet published
- `discontinued`: Discontinued
- `hiatus`: On Hiatus

parameters.name: status_exclude
parameters.description:
Exclude entries with any selected status. Multiple values exclude any selected status.

- `publishing`: Publishing
- `complete`: Finished
- `upcoming`: Not yet published
- `discontinued`: Discontinued
- `hiatus`: On Hiatus

parameters.name: genres
parameters.description: Comma-separated IDs. Entries must have all of them.

parameters.description: Comma-separated IDs. Entries with any of them are left out.

parameters.description: Comma-separated IDs. Entries must have at least one of them.

parameters.description: Exclude entries recorded under any selected magazine or serialization-platform MAL ID.

parameters.description: Filter by who made the manga: `true` for manga written and drawn by one person, `false` for manga whose writing and art are credited to two or more people. Manga that MAL lists without both a writer and an artist match neither.

parameters.name: exclude_ids
parameters.description: Exclude the entries whose MAL IDs you choose, such as the ones already on a user's list. Comma-separated. These answers are never cached.

parameters.name: score
parameters.description: Only entries with exactly this score, e.g. `8.2` for 8.20. Cannot be combined with `min_score` or `max_score`; use those for a range.

parameters.description: Only entries with this score or higher.

parameters.name: max_score
parameters.description: Only entries with this score or lower.

parameters.description: Minimum known positive chapter count, inclusive.

parameters.name: max_chapters
parameters.description: Maximum known positive chapter count, inclusive.

parameters.name: min_volumes
parameters.description: Minimum known positive volume count, inclusive.

parameters.name: max_volumes
parameters.description: Maximum known positive volume count, inclusive.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Calendar year of the aired or published start date. Cannot be combined with min_year or max_year. For anime, this can differ from MAL's season year. Multiple years match any selected year.

parameters.name: min_year
parameters.description: Minimum calendar year of the aired or published start date, inclusive. For anime, this can differ from MAL's season year.

parameters.name: max_year
parameters.description: Maximum calendar year of the aired or published start date, inclusive. For anime, this can differ from MAL's season year.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Only manga that started publishing on or after this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. A year (2020) or a year and month (2020-05) is also accepted.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Only manga that finished publishing on or before this date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. A year (2020) or a year and month (2020-05) is also accepted and covers up to its last day. Manga with no end date, such as one-shots published on a single day, are left out, as on Jikan.

parameters.name: sfw
parameters.description: Filter adult content.

parameters.name: sfw-strict
parameters.description: Apply strict SFW filtering for adult content and Ecchi.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description:

- `mal_id`: MAL ID
- `title`: Title
- `title_english`: English title
- `title_japanese`: Japanese title
- `start_date`: Start date
- `end_date`: End date
- `chapters`: Number of chapters
- `volumes`: Number of volumes
- `score`: Score
- `scored_by`: Number of users who scored it
- `rank`: Rank
- `popularity`: Popularity rank
- `members`: Members
- `favorites`: Favorites
- `score_change_30d`: Change in MAL score over 30 days
- `score_spread`: Standard deviation of user scores; higher means more disagreement
- `members_gained_7d`: Net change in members over 7 days

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort direction: `asc` for ascending, `desc` for descending. Defaults to `desc`, or to `asc` when sorting by a title.

parameters.name: nulls
parameters.description: Applies to the field you sort by with `order_by`. `first` puts entries without a value first, `last` puts them last, and `exclude` leaves them out of results and totals. Example: `order_by=end_date&nulls=exclude` leaves out entries without an end date. Requires `order_by`. When omitted, entries without a value come first with sort=asc and last with sort=desc. With `order_by=rank` or `order_by=popularity`, they come last either way, and a rank or popularity of 0 counts as no value.

data.title: Berserk
data.synopsis:
Guts, a former mercenary now known as the Black Swordsman, is out for revenge. After a tumultuous childhood, he finally finds someone he respects and believes he can trust, only to have everything fall apart when this person takes away everything important to Guts for the purpose of fulfilling his own desires. Now marked for death, Guts becomes condemned to a fate in which he is relentlessly pursued by demonic beings.

Setting out on a dreadful quest riddled with misfortune, Guts, armed with a massive sword and monstrous strength, will let nothing stop him, not even death itself, until he is finally able to take the head of the one who stripped him—and his loved one—of their humanity.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

Included one-shot:
Volume 14: Berserk: The Prototype
data.background: Berserk won the Excellence Award at the sixth Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in 2002. As of August 2025, over 70 million copies of the manga are in circulation. The series has been published in English by Dark Horse Comics since November 4, 2003. It has also been released in Argentina, Brazil, Czech Republic, France, Germany, Greece, Hong Kong, Italy, México, Poland, South Korea, Spain, Taiwan, Thailand, and Turkey. In May 2021, the author Kentaro Miura suddenly died at the age of 54. Chapter 364 of Berserk was published posthumously on September 10, 2021. Miura would often share details about the series' story with his childhood friend and fellow mangaka Kouji Mori. The series resumed on June 24, 2022, with Studio Gaga handling the art and Kouji Mori's supervision.

parameters.name: q

parameters.name: letter
parameters.description: Only entries whose name starts with this letter. One letter, in any case.

parameters.name: given_name
parameters.description: Only characters with this given name, such as `Sakura`. Matches the whole given name, ignoring case. A character MAL lists with one name, such as `Levi`, has only a given name.

parameters.name: family_name
parameters.description: Only characters with this family name, such as `Uchiha`. Matches the whole family name, ignoring case.

parameters.name: has_about
parameters.description: `true` for characters with an about text, `false` for characters without one. MAL's "No biography written." counts as none.

parameters.name: has_image
parameters.description: `true` for characters with a picture, `false` for characters that show MAL's question-mark placeholder.

parameters.name: has_nicknames
parameters.description: `true` for characters with at least one nickname, `false` for characters without any.

parameters.name: has_kanji
parameters.description: `true` for characters with a Japanese name (`name_kanji`), `false` for characters without one.

parameters.name: has_family_name
parameters.description: `true` for characters with a family name, `false` for characters MAL lists with one name, such as `Levi`.

parameters.name: anime
parameters.description: Only characters in any of these anime MAL IDs. With `voice_language`, the voice credit must be in one of these anime. Comma-separated.

parameters.name: manga
parameters.description: Only characters in any of these manga MAL IDs. Comma-separated.

parameters.description:
Only characters MAL lists in this role. With `anime` or `manga`, the role in those titles; without them, the role in any anime or manga.

- `main`: Main character

Only characters MAL lists in this role and never in the other one.
